The shop

Royal treatment on Spring Creek.

Royal Cut Plano is a full-service barbershop in Suite #400 on Spring Creek Parkway — known for careful fades, clean lineups, and barbers who take time with every client.

Regulars often praise Mohammad Al Samak (Mohammed), Moath, Bilal, Sameer, and Saeed. Beyond classic barbering, Booksy also lists aesthetician, laser, and cryo services — ask the shop when you book.
